WITH filtered_films AS (
  SELECT rating, rental_rate, rental_duration
  FROM film
  WHERE rental_duration > 5
),
rating_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) as avg_rate_per_duration,
    COUNT(*) as film_count
  FROM filtered_films
  GROUP BY rating
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_duration) as bench_value
  FROM rating_avgs
)
SELECT 
  r.rating,
  r.avg_rate_per_duration,
  r.film_count,
  r.avg_rate_per_duration / b.bench_value as ratio_to_benchmark
FROM rating_avgs r
CROSS JOIN benchmark b
ORDER BY r.rating
